q: In any electrical appliance the ____ wire is always connected to the metal case. [2026-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: The earth wire is connected to the metal casing of electrical appliances to prevent electric shocks.

q: The current from the outlet of a phone charger is ____ current. [2026-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Phone chargers convert AC mains supply into direct current (DC) to safely charge battery cells.

q: In the lighting circuit, the light bulbs are arranged in ____ across the mains line. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Lamps in lighting circuits are connected in parallel so that each receives full mains voltage and operates independently.

q: The magnitude of induced emf in a wire loop is directly proportional to the rate of change of ____ through that loop. [2026-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: According to Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction, induced emf is proportional to the rate of change of magnetic flux.

q: In the alternating current the direction of the flow of electrons changes ____. [2026-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Alternating current continually reverses its direction of electron flow at regular time intervals.

q: Magnetic field strength and magnetic flux density are ____ quantities. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Both magnetic field strength and magnetic flux density possess both magnitude and specific direction.

q: The SI unit of magnetic flux density is ____. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Magnetic flux density is measured in tesla (T) in the SI system.

q: Faraday law gives the ____ of induced emf. [2026-နိုင်ငံခြား]
e: Faraday's law determines the magnitude of induced electromotive force.

q: An alternating current is a current that reverses its ____ at regular time intervals. [2026-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Alternating current periodically changes its direction of flow at regular intervals.

q: Faraday's law gives the ____ of the induced (emf). [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Faraday's law provides the quantitative magnitude of induced electromotive force.

q: The magnitude of induced emf in a wire loop is directly proportional to the rate of change of ____ through that loop. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: The rate at which magnetic flux changes through a loop determines the magnitude of the induced emf.

q: Lenz's law is a good example of the principle of conservation of ____. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Lenz's law complies with the law of conservation of energy.

q: Magnetic flux density is related to magnetic field strength by ____. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Magnetic flux density B relates to magnetic field strength H via permeability μ.

q: The currents flow in little circles in the iron core are called ____. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Circulating loops of induced electrical current within iron cores are called eddy currents.

q: The ____ wire is usually at zero volt. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: The neutral and earth wires are maintained at zero potential relative to ground.

q: In an AC circuit, the voltage and current vary sinusoidally with time, whereas in a DC circuit, both the voltage and current remain constant over ____. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Direct current maintains constant voltage and current values regardless of time.

q: A transformer is used to change the ____ of an alternating current. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Transformers step up or step down alternating voltage levels.

q: In the lighting circuit, the light bulbs are arranged in ____ across the mains line. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Lamps connected in parallel each receive full mains voltage.

q: In power transmission, transformers are utilized to adjust the ____. [2025-နိုင်ငံခြား]
e: Transformers adjust transmission voltage and current to minimize energy loss over long distances.

q: In an electric generator, ____ energy is converted into electrical energy. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Generators convert mechanical rotational energy into electrical energy.

q: Magnetic flux density is a ____ quantity. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Magnetic flux density is a vector quantity having both magnitude and direction.

q: When increased the voltage 10 kV to 20 kV at the power station, the power loss will be reduced to ____ times. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Doubling transmission voltage reduces current by half, which reduces I²R power loss by 4 times.

q: For one turn of a wire loop, the magnitude of induced emf is ____. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: For a single turn loop, induced emf equals the rate of change of magnetic flux.

q: Bulbs in electrical wiring of houses are connected in ____ across the mains line. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Household lighting wiring connects appliances in parallel across the mains voltage.

q: Faraday's law gives the ____ of the induced emf. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Faraday's law states the magnitude of induced electromotive force.

q: The live wire is the dangerous wire because it carries a high voltage while the neutral wire is close to ____ voltage. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: The neutral wire completes the electrical circuit at near zero voltage.

q: The core of a transformer is built up of thin iron sheets of high resistance called ____. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Lamination reduces eddy current losses in the transformer core.

q: One way to reduce power loss is to use very thick cables of ____ resistance. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Thick transmission wires have larger cross-sectional areas and low electrical resistance.

q: The lamps are connected in ____ in the lighting circuit. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Lamps in lighting circuits are connected in parallel.

q: The direct current is a steady ____ current. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Direct current flows continuously in one direction.

q: Lenz's law is a good example of the principle of conservation of ____. [2025-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Lenz's law is an application of the law of conservation of energy.

q: In the alternating current the direction of the flow of electrons changes ____. [2026-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Electron flow direction in alternating current reverses periodically.

q: ____ law gives the magnitude of the induced emf in electromagnetic induction. [2026-ပြည်တွင်း]
e: Faraday's law gives the magnitude of induced emf.

q: A rotating coil in a magnetic field is the basic of an ____. [2026-နိုင်ငံခြား]
e: An AC generator works by rotating a coil in a magnetic field.

q: The power sockets in a house are connected by means of a ____. [2026-နိုင်ငံခြား]
e: Power sockets are wired in a ring main circuit.
